title: vim.cmd.make causes neovim to crash

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.8.0-dev-804-gbebfbfab3b

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

n/a

### Operating system/version

Arch Linux

### Terminal name/version

foot

### $TERM environment variable

foot

### Installation

AUR

### How to reproduce the issue

```
nvim --clean
:lua vim.cmd.make()
```

### Expected behavior

Neovim runs makeprg like `:make`

### Actual behavior

Neovim crashes with the following message:
`/home/main-builder/pkgwork/src/neovim-git/src/nvim/api/command.c:822: build_cmdline_str: Assertion argc == 1 failed.`
